title: An interrupted update
scenario: Return to a point after a prepared interruption.
partnerRole: A patient ordinary conversation partner appropriate to this scenario.
opening: Let us practise an interrupted update. What would you like to tell me or ask?
scriptedPrompts: Prepared interruption: Before you finish, I want to discuss something else.
Return to the point you wanted to complete.
Take a moment to add or clarify something you want understood.
Make one relevant request or ask a follow-up of your choice.
Close the exchange in a way that fits your purpose.
fixedDialogueDisclosure: These prompts are prepared; they do not respond to your answer.
steps: Choose a purpose and optional tool.
Read the scenario and listen to the opening.
Complete up to six learner turns.
reflection: What did you want to communicate?
